summary: A hand-written grammar MoE (prefix-unit lexicon trunk, factored one-hot clause-state registers, router over NP/post-noun/tail/punct experts) reaches 0.7125 bpc on the first dev-eval from uniform (5.0).

Docs end at the first period at or after character 150 (from my hand counts). An eos logit ramp on the step input cut after_period bits from 0.815 to 0.001 bpc, and total bpc went 0.7125 -> 0.6849 together with a lower word floor and rate recalibration.

Final proposal: 0.6819 bpc, top1 0.806 on 300 dev docs. word_start is 69% of the bits (2.97 bpc) and in_word 0.21 bpc. The worst positions are rare but grammatical choices, with no grammar violations.
Route counts on dev (final): ex_np 35341, ex_post 15647, ex_tail 2072, ex_punct 1426. The router is driven only by the recurrent phase register and by prev punctuation.
Rate calibration (adj rate, det mix, clause-2 flag, follow-up rates) gave only 0.0017 bpc over evals 002-004. The remaining loss is probably intrinsic choice entropy of the generator.
